claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of the actually inspected primary claims logically entails equality at 44 for the stated object. An inaccessible edit-metric thesis may contain indirect bounds but no decisive same-parameter statement was available. An edit-metric minimum-distance requirement of three can exclude pairs differing by two substitutions that are nevertheless distinguishable after a single deletion; hence a published edit-metric optimum is not automatically the optimum for the deletion-only channel. Likewise, a single fixed-GC layer differs from the union of GC weights two and three and a reverse-complement distance condition differs from mandatory strand-pair closure.
